control: live positive control for the R14-H136 census on quant_misbind
source: real RAGBench arena documents (the reference side itself), degraded
baseline_lane_reads: conformed member evidence gate max fraction 0.0, claim gate 0.0 against the same arena

verbatim.note: identical arena text - the upper anchor

drop_2pct.note: 2% of whitespace tokens deleted at random

drop_5pct.note: 5% of whitespace tokens deleted at random

drop_10pct.note: 10% of whitespace tokens deleted at random

drop_5pct_cut_60pct.note: 5% deleted then cut to 60% of length

cut_50pct.note: first half of the document only

reading: the gate fires on real near-duplicate text and its detection degrades with the damage applied, while the member itself reads 0.000 against the same reference side - so the member's clean verdict comes from a live instrument
